title: What's Your Food Personality Type?
description: Answer 12 delicious questions to discover your food personality type—unlock your culinary identity!

questions.text: You're drawn to foods that are...
You cook for special occasions by...

options.text: Try every cuisine in the world

results.title: The Social Eater (ESFJ)
results.description: You're the outgoing, generous social eater! Like an ESFJ, you view food as a way to connect with others, love hosting dinner parties, and enjoy trying new restaurants with friends. You're nurturing, generous, and find joy in sharing delicious food with the people you care about. Your ideal meals are shared with loved ones, whether it's a fancy restaurant or a casual potluck with friends.

results.title: The Solo Foodie (INTP)
results.description: You're the curious, analytical solo foodie! Like an INTP, you enjoy exploring new flavors and cuisines alone, love experimenting with recipes in your kitchen, and find joy in the intellectual side of food. You're analytical, curious, and enjoy the process of cooking and eating as a personal, introspective experience. Your ideal meals are unique, interesting, and give you the chance to explore new flavors and techniques.

results.title: The Practical Cook (ISTJ)
results.description: You're the reliable, practical cook! Like an ISTJ, you value routine, nutrition, and convenience in your food choices. You follow recipes strictly, meal prep regularly, and view food as fuel for your body. You're organized, reliable, and find comfort in consistent, healthy meals that keep your life running smoothly. Your ideal meals are simple, nutritious, and easy to prepare.

results.title: The Creative Chef (ENFP)
results.description: You're the optimistic, creative chef! Like an ENFP, you love experimenting with flavors and techniques, enjoy fusion cuisine, and view cooking as a creative outlet. You're spontaneous, creative, and always up for trying new recipes or inventing your own dishes. Your ideal meals are unique, colorful, and full of unexpected flavor combinations that surprise and delight your taste buds.

results.title: The Comfort Food Lover (ISFJ)
results.description: You're the nurturing, compassionate comfort food lover! Like an ISFJ, you find joy in classic, comforting dishes that remind you of home and childhood. You love cooking for your loved ones, value tradition in your food choices, and find comfort in familiar flavors and recipes. Your ideal meals are warm, comforting, and full of love—whether it's your mom's famous pasta or a hearty bowl of soup on a cold day.

results.title: The Gourmet Explorer (ENTJ)
results.description: You're the ambitious, strategic gourmet explorer! Like an ENTJ, you seek out the best restaurants, love fine dining experiences, and approach food with a sense of adventure and ambition. You're a natural leader in the kitchen, love hosting elaborate dinner parties, and value quality and excellence in your food choices. Your ideal meals are sophisticated, well-executed, and full of complex flavors that challenge your palate.

results.title: The Adventurous Taster (ESTP)
results.description: You're the bold, spontaneous adventurous taster! Like an ESTP, you love trying new and exotic foods, enjoy street food and local specialties when traveling, and approach eating with a sense of adventure and curiosity. You're practical, adaptable, and always up for trying something new—whether it's a spicy pepper or an exotic fruit you've never heard of. Your ideal meals are bold, flavorful, and full of excitement.

results.title: The Healthy Eater (INTJ)
results.description: You're the analytical, strategic healthy eater! Like an INTJ, you approach food with a logical, strategic mindset, value nutrition and balance, and view eating as a way to optimize your health and wellbeing. You research nutrition extensively, plan your meals carefully, and find joy in creating healthy, delicious meals that fuel your body and mind. Your ideal meals are balanced, nutritious, and full of fresh, whole ingredients that support your health goals.

results.title: The Party Cook (ESFP)
results.description: You're the energetic, spontaneous party cook! Like an ESFP, you love cooking for crowds, enjoy grilling and outdoor cooking, and find joy in the social side of food. You're fun-loving, energetic, and always up for hosting a barbecue or potluck with friends. Your ideal meals are casual, flavorful, and perfect for sharing with a big group of people.

results.title: The Food Artist (INFP)
results.description: You're the idealistic, creative food artist! Like an INFP, you view food as art, love beautiful presentation, and find joy in the aesthetic side of cooking and eating. You're introspective, creative, and enjoy creating meals that are as beautiful as they are delicious. Your ideal meals are colorful, artistic, and full of meaning—whether it's a beautifully plated dessert or a meal that tells a story.

results.title: The Traditional Cook (ESTJ)
results.description: You're the reliable, traditional cook! Like an ESTJ, you value family recipes, cultural traditions, and consistency in your food choices. You're organized, reliable, and find comfort in cooking the same dishes your family has made for generations. Your ideal meals are classic, well-executed, and full of cultural significance that connects you to your heritage.

results.title: The Flavor Explorer (ENTP)
results.description: You're the curious, innovative flavor explorer! Like an ENTP, you love experimenting with new flavor combinations, enjoy fusion cuisine, and approach food with a sense of curiosity and innovation. You're witty, creative, and always up for debating the merits of different cuisines or inventing your own unique dishes. Your ideal meals are unexpected, complex, and full of interesting flavor combinations that challenge your taste buds.

results.title: The Simple Cook (ISFP)
results.description: You're the gentle, spontaneous simple cook! Like an ISFP, you value simplicity, fresh ingredients, and the natural flavors of food. You're creative, practical, and enjoy cooking simple, delicious meals with minimal fuss. Your ideal meals are fresh, simple, and full of natural flavor—whether it's a fresh salad with homemade dressing or a perfectly cooked piece of fish with herbs from your garden.

results.title: The Host with the Most (ENFJ)
results.description: You're the charismatic, generous host with the most! Like an ENFJ, you love hosting elaborate dinner parties, enjoy creating memorable dining experiences for your loved ones, and find joy in the art of hospitality. You're compassionate, generous, and go above and beyond to make sure your guests have a wonderful time. Your ideal meals are carefully planned, beautifully presented, and full of love and care for your guests.

results.title: The Mindful Eater (INFJ)
results.description: You're the compassionate, intuitive mindful eater! Like an INFJ, you approach food with mindfulness and intention, value quality over quantity, and find joy in the sensory experience of eating. You're introspective, empathetic, and enjoy savoring each bite and appreciating the effort that went into creating your meal. Your ideal meals are nourishing, intentional, and full of meaning that nourishes both your body and soul.

results.title: The Flexible Foodie (ESTP)
results.description: You're the adaptable, practical flexible foodie! Like an ESTP, you're comfortable cooking with whatever ingredients you have on hand, enjoy improvising in the kitchen, and approach food with a practical, adaptable mindset. You're quick-thinking, resourceful, and can turn a few random ingredients into a delicious meal with ease. Your ideal meals are creative, practical, and full of flavor—no recipe required!
